import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
meta = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/room-churn-reuse-candidate.json').read_text())
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
servers = {'before': root / meta['baseline_path'], 'selected': root / meta['directory'] / 'war-relay'}
client = root / meta['helper']['directory'] / 'inspection'
output = root / 'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-room-churn-reuse-comparison.json'
cohorts = [(1, 64, 1, 2), (1, 64, 16, 2), (1, 512, 1, 2), (1, 512, 16, 2),
           (1, 512, 1, 0), (1, 512, 16, 0), (4, 512, 1, 2), (4, 512, 16, 2)]
record = {'scope': '48 sequential fresh processes: three alternating pairs per cohort, six seconds each. One/four native workers,64/512 stable readers,1/16-message windows; every2 windows one temporary reader joins before a broadcast and completes exact Close/EOF plus departure at every survivor. Membership updates are gated between complete windows, not concurrent with an intentionally suspended route. Stable512-reader guards have no membership churn. No private traffic or other churn/inspection. Same frozen verifying client and body cycle. Server CPUs0-3/client4-7. No builds, injection, profiling or competing loads overlap timing. CPU per output message uses all timed verified application outputs, including welcomes/departures, with exact body/counter checks.',
          'candidate': meta, 'variants': {key: {'path': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(path)} for key, path in servers.items()},
          'client': {'path': str(client.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(client)},
          'helpers': {name: sha(root / 'scripts' / name) for name in ['inspection.py', 'benchmark.py']},
          'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'cases': [], 'passed': False}
for repetition in range(1, 4):
    ordered = cohorts if repetition % 2 else list(reversed(cohorts))
    for workers, readers, window, every in ordered:
        cohort = f'w{workers}-r{readers}-b{window}-c{every}'
        for role in (['before', 'selected'] if repetition % 2 else ['selected', 'before']):
            trace = output.with_name(f'2026-10-16-room-churn-reuse-{cohort}-{role}-{repetition}.json')
            command = [sys.executable, str(root / 'scripts/inspection.py'), '--server', str(servers[role]), '--client', str(client),
                       '--rooms', '0', '--pairs', '0', '--mode', 'none', '--inspectors', '0', '--churn-workers', '0',
                       '--fanout-readers', str(readers), '--fanout-window', str(window), '--fanout-churn-every', str(every),
                       '--seconds', '6', '--workers', str(workers), '--output', str(trace)]
            done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
            data = json.loads(trace.read_text()); assert done.returncode == 0 and data['passed'], done.stdout + done.stderr
            assert not data['profile_diagnostic'] and data['server_sha256'] == record['variants'][role]['sha256']
            assert data['client_sha256'] == record['client']['sha256'] == meta['helper']['client_sha256']
            assert data['server_exit_code'] == data['client_exit_code'] == 0 and not data['server_forced_kill']
            m = data['mixed']; initial, measured = data['events'][:2]
            count = measured['details']['counts']['deliveries'] - initial['details']['counts']['deliveries']
            row = {'cohort': cohort, 'workers': workers, 'readers': readers, 'window': window, 'every': every,
                   'kind': role, 'repetition': repetition, 'passed': True, 'trace': str(trace.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(trace),
                   'fanout': m['fanout']['per_second'], 'fanout_p99_ms': m['fanout']['p99_upper_ms'],
                   'membership': m['fanout_membership']['per_second'], 'membership_p99_ms': m['fanout_membership']['p99_upper_ms'],
                   'wire_deliveries': count, 'cpu_ns_per_output': m['server_cpu_seconds'] * 1e9 / count,
                   'cpu_wall': m['server_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second'], 'client_cpu_wall': m['client_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second'],
                   'rss_mib': measured['process']['VmRSS'] / 1024}
            record['cases'].append(row); output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n'); print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
record['medians'] = {}
for workers, readers, window, every in cohorts:
    cohort = f'w{workers}-r{readers}-b{window}-c{every}'
    for role in servers:
        rows = [row for row in record['cases'] if row['cohort'] == cohort and row['kind'] == role]
        fields = ['fanout', 'fanout_p99_ms', 'membership', 'membership_p99_ms', 'cpu_ns_per_output', 'cpu_wall', 'client_cpu_wall', 'rss_mib']
        summary = {key: statistics.median(row[key] for row in rows) for key in fields}
        summary['ranges'] = {key: [min(row[key] for row in rows), max(row[key] for row in rows)] for key in fields}
        record['medians'][cohort + '/' + role] = summary
record['passed'] = True
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(record['medians']), flush=True)
